name: 精緻圖
description: 步驟 5：依分鏡、角色與實景照片產生每格精緻圖。
system: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 frame for a tourism short video. Use the supplied location photo as the real background and keep its architecture accurate. Keep the character identical to the supplied character sheet. Respectful depiction of temples and deities. No text, no logos, no identifiable real bystanders.
